verdict.rationale: Orb is API-first, so it can run headlessly. Core workflows are documented as API-driven: creating subscriptions, editing them, ingesting usage events and issuing invoices can all be done via API instead of the UI. Official SDKs in six languages, idempotent retries, cursor pagination, programmatic error handling and webhooks make unattended automation practical. Missing for 10: no documented CLI or CI-pipeline integration, no public OpenAPI spec found by the probe, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.
